comments.author: YoGolan
comments.body:
Seems steps 5,6 and 7 can be in any order. Order I did was.

1. Seville Archives - Talk to Scholar
2. Seville Archives - Read Archaeology books (r13 Archaeology|Spanish Required)
3. Seville Archives - Talk to Scholar ×2
5. Portobelo - Talk to Market Keeper
6. Portobelo - Talk to Young Man (Near the shore)
7. Portobelo - Talk to Maiden (Near the shore)
8. Portobelo - Talk to Raul
9. Mayan Lowlands - Search for most south Table Boulder and click on it
10. Mayan Lowlands - Search on the entrance of Palenque dungeon
